children.game_version: A follow-the-leader game where children move in lines mimicking the lead dancer.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the rhythmic arm movements and vocal parts while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the forward and backward steps with support if necessary, focusing on the rhythm.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and limited range of motion.

movement_profile.footwork: Forwards and backwards movement in lines.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two or three lines moving in a drill formation around central drums.

signature_moves.description: Coordinated forward and backward movement in two or three lines.
signature_moves.name: Line Drill

signature_moves.description: Lead dancers circling the central drums.
signature_moves.name: Drum Circle

music_profile.sound_description: A percussive, drum-heavy sound featuring a lead vocalist and a chorus singing satirical lyrics, designed to accompany a structured dance drill.

basic_steps: Step forward in unison to the drumbeat.
Step backward in unison to the drumbeat.
Lead dancers move around the central drums.
teaching.formation: Two or three lines with drums at the center.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on maintaining the line formation while moving forward and backward in time with the drums.
